\[
B_S=\prod_{j=1}^{d}[a_{S,j},b_{S,j}]\subseteq\mathbb R^d\qquad(S\in V),
\]

\[
B_S\cap B_T\ne\varnothing\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad S\cap T=\varnothing.
\]
